name: Black Loves & Lies
source:
Welcome to your new town: Withery Beach!
You play as Cassiopée Tellier (name customizable), a 21-year-old witch, who has just arrived from Canada, hoping to enroll in some... rather unusual classes. You will soon discover that this quiet little seaside town in the south of France harbors many secrets.
You expected a peaceful year focused on the reason you came, but you’re in for a rude awakening. Because if there’s one place you really shouldn't be, it’s Withery Beach. Amidst the secrets, action, and discoveries, you’ll have to deal with a little crush that wasn't part of the plan at all...

[Translated from [url=https://ceris15.itch.io/black-loves-lies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到你的新家：枯影海滩（Withery Beach）！
你将扮演21岁的女巫卡西奥佩·特利耶（姓名可自定义）。她刚刚从加拿大远道而来，希望能报读几门……颇为不同寻常的课程。你很快便会发现，这座位于法国南部的宁静海滨小镇，实则暗藏着数不清的秘密。
你原本以为等待自己的会是专注于求学初衷的平静一年，现实却给你浇了一盆冷水——因为要论世上哪个地方你最不该踏足，那非枯影海滩莫属。在重重秘密、惊险行动与意外发现之间，你还得招架一段完全不在计划之内的怦然心动……

[译自[url=https://ceris15.itch.io/black-loves-lies]itch.io[/url]]
